{{Top|leg}}
[[Galactic Solutions Industries]] maintained a '''Natural Weapons Division''' that researched and developed weaponry that used natural phenomena, such as electromagnetic and gravitational fields. One of the division's research projects was the study of crashed [[Starship/Legends|starships]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], as they hoped to duplicate and weaponize the planet's unique combination of electromagnetic and gravitational fields that caused frequent crashes.
